title: Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK): Uncontrolled recursion (crash DoS) in DependencyGraph.tree()/triples()…
description: The Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) DependencyGraph component uses unbounded recursion in its tree() and triples() methods to walk parsed dependency structures, which can lead to a crash via RecursionError when processing crafted long dependency chains. This occurs because these methods do not use the class's cycle detection and lack recursion depth limits, unlike other parts of NLTK. An attacker supplying a maliciously long dependency-parse file can cause denial of service by crashing the process. This issue affects versions prior to 3.10.4 and has been fixed in 3.10.4.
